nodes.question: Which corporations had the most board seat positions among the executive members of the multi-stakeholder institutions?
nodes.answer: The corporations with the most board seat positions were Unilever (20), Nestlé (17), PepsiCo Inc (14), and The Coca-Cola Company (13).
